snippet.title: Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay Trailer For Mr. Magpie's Harmless Card Game. Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game is a Minesweeper-Roguelike with Deckbuilder elements. Make your quota before the time runs out or risk the consequences! Mr Magpie's Harmless Card game is coming to PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616280/Mr_Magpies_Harmless_Card_Game/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
